metadata.name: Sylt trawl survey (2021) – fish & environment
metadata.description: Dataset of six records from a single benthic trawl event (Event = Sylt_trawl) around Sylt, Germany in 2021. It includes latitude, longitude, two depth measurements, habitat type, Atlantic mackerel (Scomber scombrus) total length and count, salinity, temperature, and timestamps (Date/Time and Date/Time_2). All records have complete data (0 missing values), the habitat is uniformly Benthic, and the spatial extent spans approximately 3 km north‑south by 2.5 km east‑west.
